name: Alex Morgan
tagline: A thoughtful move. A place of your own.
bio: I believe a good move begins with a good conversation. My approach brings clear communication, thoughtful preparation, and personal attention to every step of buying or selling a home.
seoDescription: Personal real estate guidance for buyers and sellers. Explore the process, meet your local agent, and plan your next move.

content.voice: Warm, clear, practical. Explain jargon and avoid hype.
